description: This Kotlin source file defines the GatewayEventHandler class which manages wake word synchronization with a gateway, including scheduling updates, handling incoming events, and communicating with the GatewaySession.

classes.name: GatewayEventHandler
classes.description: Handles voice wake word synchronization with a remote gateway, including scheduling, updating, and processing event payloads.

methods.name: applyWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Sets wake words locally and suppresses sync while updating preferences.

methods.name: scheduleWakeWordsSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed request to synchronize wake words with the gateway if conditions allow.

methods.name: refreshWakeWordsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the current wake word triggers from the gateway and applies them locally.

methods.name: handleVoiceWakeChangedEvent
methods.description: Processes a JSON payload indicating a change in voice wake triggers and updates local state.
